original_candidates.question_text: What factors do you think could affect how this service influences people in your neighbourhood?
original_candidates.origin: User-supplied starting candidate; not an FN-approved question.

original_candidates.question_text: What information, if any, would help you form an informed view?
original_candidates.origin: User-supplied starting candidate; not an FN-approved question.

original_candidates.question_text: Have you taken part in a discussion, consultation or demonstration about this or a similar service? If so, what did you contribute?
original_candidates.origin: User-supplied starting candidate; not an FN-approved question.

original_candidates.origin: User-supplied starting candidate; not an FN-approved question.

indicators.question_text: What effects do you think this service could have on daily life, and why?
indicators.clarification_text: Is there an effect on daily life you would like to explain? You can also skip.
indicators.evidence_requirements: Specific explanation of possible impacts; agreement, enthusiasm or copied scenario facts alone are insufficient.

indicators.question_text: What would you want to find out about this service before deciding? You can also say you have enough information.
indicators.clarification_text: Is there a particular question you would want answered about this service? You can also skip.
indicators.evidence_requirements: Explicit evidence needs, uncertainty, or a stated absence of additional information needs.

indicators.question_text: Have you taken part in a discussion, consultation or demonstration about drones or a similar transport service? If yes, what did you contribute?
indicators.clarification_text: Have you actually taken part in a discussion or consultation, or were you describing something you would like to do? You can also say no or skip.
indicators.evidence_requirements: Separate an actual activity and contribution from hypothetical willingness, assessment participation and explicit absence of experience.

indicators.question_text: Did anything change following your contribution? What changed, if anything?
indicators.clarification_text: What changed after your contribution, if anything, or is the outcome unknown to you?
indicators.evidence_requirements: A reported outcome linked to an actual contribution; unknown outcome remains unknown. Self-report is not independent verification.

indicators.question_text: Do you know how you could give feedback or take part in decisions about a proposal like this? Is anything preventing you from taking part?
indicators.clarification_text: Do you know of a way to give feedback or take part? It is fine to say you do not know, or to skip.
indicators.evidence_requirements: A reported available route to participate, explicit lack of opportunity or barrier; no interest is not lack of opportunity.
